# IFN response and OA markers (mixed)

Differential expression analysis in the IFN-stimulated cohort showed activation of antiviral genes. IFIT1 was upregulated (Table 2). ISG15 was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 2). OAS1 was downregulated in the IFN samples (Table 2). IFIT3 was upregulated as expected (Table 2). MX1 was upregulated (Table 2).

Cartilage matrix genes showed the expected pattern. ACAN was upregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 2).
